review_text: The Move In Sync app crashes frequently, making it unreliable for daily use. App stability needs serious improvement. It would be very useful to have a feature to add colleagues to Favorites, allowing users to check their login and logout timings and match schedules on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis with transport details on click. This would greatly improve coordination and planning. The app has good potential, but performance issues and missing features reduce the overall experience.
reviewer_notes: Frequent crashes plus a request for colleague favourites and schedule coordination; not an explicit booking failure.
